    # the weight block and every per-feature vector span all of N: the row reduction must see whole rows
    return pl.pallas_call(
        _kernel,
        out_shape=jax.ShapeDtypeStruct((M, 1), x.dtype),
        grid=(M // tm, K // tk),
        in_specs=[pl.BlockSpec((tm, tk), lambda i, l: (i, l)), pl.BlockSpec((tk, N), lambda i, l: (l, 0))],
        out_specs=pl.BlockSpec((tm, 1), lambda i, l: (i, 0)),
        scratch_shapes=[pltpu.VMEM((tm, N), jnp.float32)],
        compiler_params=pltpu.CompilerParams(dimension_semantics=("parallel", "arbitrary"), vmem_limit_bytes=VMEM_LIMIT),
    )(x, weight)
